name: Primeval
description:
Primeval adds a GPU Quick Settings tile to switch NVIDIA PRIME profiles.

Maps prime-select modes to short labels:
* Integrated (intel)
* Dedicated (nvidia)
* Optimus (on-demand)

Expanded menu shows live GPU stats from nvtop -s (device name, memory used/total, GPU and memory utilization).

Requires nvidia-prime (prime-select), pkexec, and nvtop. Switching profiles runs `pkexec prime-select <profile>` and usually needs a logout or reboot to apply.
